caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Oct 26–31 is here.

Shoulder sore at night? Lying on your back with a pillow under the sore arm can help. Woke up with a stiff neck? Turn, tilt and nod, five each, every hour. Tailbone pain when sitting often eases with a cut-out cushion and standing every 30 minutes. And in the first 48 hours of a flare-up, a few minutes' walk every hour keeps you moving.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
